rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the context makes clear that you mean someone's way of living rather than life in general.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ji4 gaa1 ni1 zung2 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that you mean a person's or group's style or pattern of living.

example.english: Young people's lifestyle is very different from before.
example.traditional: 年輕人嘅生活方式同以前好唔同。
example.jyutping: nin4 hing1 jan4 ge3 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1 tung4 ji5 cin4 hou2 m4 tung4
